snippet.title: Fallfate - Official Trailer - Nextfest
snippet.description:
Fallfate is coming to Nextfest!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3961470/Fallfate_Impulsive_Plinko

Fallfate is short, action-packed roguelike plinko. Parry enemies and bosses. Defy house's edge with spins. Chase losses with resolve and upgrades, until you master the true nature of fate.
